phase_A_basis: Phase A chunk A1 only (96/96 COMP trials verified and valid, 32 per class, EXCLUSIVE quiet-timed + cargo lock, every round started at 1-minute loadavg <= 4.0, trial loadavg mean 3.22). Per-mark cost c_m = 32.33 us. Values are corrected (c_m) per-task means in ms with the 95% CI, recomputed by analyze_b07.py from raw/. The overhead control (chunk O*) was running when this file was written and does not enter the selection rule.
selection_rule: PREREG selection_rule: selected iff the target sub-span's Phase A corrected per-task mean >= 0.5 ms in at least one class

not_selected.ROUTE_FAST: c_out.route corrected mean < 0.5 ms in every class (CI upper < 0.5 ms in every class): BELOW_GATE by PREREG unselected_rule; not run

candidates.work_metric: prep_ms (sum of call_send -> c.req_written over in-T calls)
driver_window_ms (sum of c.req_written -> c.first_byte over in-T calls)

n4a: chunk prefix N: 5 rounds x 3 classes in each of COMP_OFF, PREP_FAST, POST_FAST (15 per arm)
phase_B_design: PREREG phase_B unchanged: 30 AB/BA rounds per class per candidate, COMP_OFF first in AB rounds
